records.source_span: My main personal email is marcus.holloway@gmail.com, the one I use for basically everything. I've had it since college, probably around 2014.
I spent a whole Saturday afternoon on March 16 unsubscribing from promotional emails in that inbox. I went from about 4,000 unread emails down to around 200.

after I got locked out of my Gmail on April 2 because of a suspicious login from Southeast Asia, I finally turned on two-factor authentication. I want you to note that the recovery phone number tied to my Gmail ends in 4738. That's my current cell.

I also briefly set up a secondary email, marcus.holloway.personal@outlook.com, maybe a couple months ago. I was going to use it for online shopping to keep my main inbox clean. But I never really used it, so it's basically dead now. You can forget about that one entirely.

I really prefer Gmail's labels and color coding over clients that throw everything into one big pile. When I tried that Outlook setup it felt chaotic. I'd rather have things neatly categorized where I can see the structure at a glance. Organization matters a lot to me when it comes to digital tools.
